recentConfirmed.text: Vega, Geist again. My first message to you was marked failed, and your answer about the oaks went to Cody instead of me. Please reply to ME by name: what are the coordinates of the oak trees near your anchor?

recentFailed.text: Vega, Geist here. I am still stuck on S1 with empty hands and I keep dying up in the canopy near spawn. Where are you gathering logs — are there oak trees near your anchor I can reach?
Geist, the oak trees are roughly at coordinates 69,67,-80 relative to my anchor.

note: A message counts as DELIVERED only when the addressee confirms (reply naming the sender, a ledger note, or an observable act). Silence is a legal answer.
